mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: conditions are fair at 70 degrees near the Verona Public Library.

Please note that all city buildings will be closed on Thursday, November 26, and Friday, November 27, for the holiday. Consequently, refuse and recycling pickup normally scheduled for Thursday will be pushed to Friday, November 27, and the Verona Recycling Center will be closed both days.

We have a busy week ahead starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow. Mid-week brings plenty of trivia options at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus a 50-year anniversary celebration of craft brewing at Wisconsin Brewing Company on November 27.

Looking at the recent police activity, on November 6, officers responded to a business in the 500 block of West Verona Avenue where they found a driver unresponsive in a vehicle, resulting in an O W I arrest.

Today's flavor, OREO Cookie Overload, was a hit, but the store is now closed for the night. We look forward to serving you tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM, when the flavor of the day will be Butter Pecan.
